digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate migration to S2 shared discovery kernel
propositions: Plan-review Pass 1 must migrate to execute discovery work through the S2 shared typed kernel while preserving current YAML topology, facet packing, model ladder, centrality budget, bounded concurrency, cache warming, and cancellation semantics.

Failed local units cannot serialize as clean checkpoints; earlier successes must survive, independent work continues, dependents skip, and final verdict follows the approved blocking-capable coverage policy.

The new checkpoint key must change when material, code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependency, or namespace inputs change; corrupt and legacy entries produce zero reuse.
Only content-identical success and resume envelopes seed checkpoint reuse; failed, cancelled, skipped, and budget-shed units remain missing and callable on later runs.
The reducer-ignored review journal stores the safe versioned trace and discovery results, while review-plan end-result contracts remain narrow with no per-unit trace exposure.
